_comment: Rendered by mapi_plots (packages/plots-core examples.training_tree) for the dl.cnn_classifier mock run (mocks/dl.ts). Not generated by make snapshots.

ml.confusion_epochs.caption_plain: Each matrix counts the validation images by the true class (rows) and the predicted class (columns) at one epoch, for 3 classes. Each row shows the share of the images of a true class. The validation accuracy is 60% at epoch 1, 100% at the best epoch (7) and 95% at epoch 10. The plot shows 6 of the 10 kept epochs.
ml.confusion_epochs.title: Confusion matrix over epochs

ml.misclassified.caption_plain: 17 of 60 validation images are wrong at epoch 7. The grid shows 12 of them, in order of the probability of the wrong class. Each title gives the true class, the predicted class and its probability. The mean probability of the true class for these images is 0.25. The plot shows 12 of the 17 wrong images.
ml.misclassified.title: Wrong validation images

ml.training_curves.caption_plain: The plot shows loss and accuracy at each step of the training, with one line for each split: train and val. The dark line of train is the moving average over 8 points. The light line is the value of each batch. The best validation loss is 0.23 at step 280. The best validation accuracy is 98% at step 280. The validation loss goes up while the training loss goes down: the model starts to overfit. The model keeps the weights of epoch 7.
ml.training_curves.title: Training curves
